description: 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN reports '10', and that is still a failure. This is the case most likely to be translated wrongly, because '10' is the benign end-of-file status everywhere else in the program: 1000-CARDFILE-GET-NEXT tests for it explicitly at app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:98 and treats it as an orderly end. The open paragraph does not test for it at all. :121 asks only whether the status is '00', so '10' takes the ELSE at :124, APPL-RESULT becomes 12, APPL-EOF is never consulted, and the program emits 'ERROR OPENING CARDFILE', the status image '0010', and 'ABENDING PROGRAM' before abending with RETURN-CODE 12. An implementation that shared one status-handling routine between the open and the read would report a clean, empty, successful run here.
